# Cody

Cody is an AI-powered assistant that uses the magic of ChatGPT meets the expertise of a custom-made AI assistant trained on your specific business.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cody/.

## Actions

- **Create Conversation**: Create a new conversation with a specified bot.
- **Create Document**: Create a new document with text or HTML content in Cody AI.
- **Create Document from Webpage**: Create a document from a publicly accessible webpage URL.
- **Delete Document**: Delete a document by id.
- **List Bots** (read-only): Get all bots with optional keyword filtering.
- **List Conversations** (read-only): Get all conversations with optional filtering by bot, keyword, or includes.
- **List Documents** (read-only): Retrieve all documents from Cody AI account with optional filtering.
- **List Folders** (read-only): Retrieve all folders with optional keyword filtering.
- **List Messages** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of messages from Cody, optionally filtered by conversation.
- **Send Message**: Send a message to Cody AI and receive an AI-generated response.
- **Create Document From File**: Create a document by uploading a file (up to 100 MB).
- **Create Folder**: Create a new folder in Cody AI for organizing content.
- **Delete Conversation**: Delete a conversation by its ID.
- **Get Conversation** (read-only): Fetch a conversation by its ID from Cody AI.
- **Get Document** (read-only): Retrieve a specific document by its identifier from Cody AI.
- **Get Folder** (read-only): Retrieve a specific folder by its identifier.
- **Get Message** (read-only): Fetch a specific message by its ID from Cody AI.
- **Get Upload Signed URL**: Get an AWS S3 signed upload URL for file uploads.
- **Send Message for Stream**: Send a message to Cody AI and receive a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream URL for the AI response.
- **Update Conversation**: Update a conversation by its ID including name, bot_id, and document_ids.
- **Update Folder**: Update a folder by its ID.
